name: bug-report-form
title: Bug report form
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Card form for a bug report: title, description, type chips, priority, environment, and a screenshot dropzone, with validation and submit states.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjeta para reportar un error: tipo, prioridad, entorno y captura, con validación y estados de envío.

examples.title: Reportar un error
examples.description: Tipo, prioridad, entorno y captura. El envío de prueba tarda un segundo y medio.

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Receives title, description, type, priority, environment, and files. Resolve for success. Reject for the retry state.

api.name: types / priorities
api.description: Chip options. Priority tone is muted, primary, or destructive. Defaults are UI issue, Functionality, Performance, Other, and Low, Medium, High.

api.name: labels
api.description: Every visible string, including errors, the submit labels, and the dropzone hint. {max} is replaced in the size and count messages.

api.name: defaultValues / values / onValuesChange
api.description: Uncontrolled defaults, or a controlled value object. Priority defaults to medium when that option exists.

api.name: accept / maxSizeMB / maxFiles
api.description: Screenshot rules. Defaults: JPG and PNG, 5 MB, 1 file. Paste an image onto the form to attach it.

api.name: autoDetectEnvironment
api.description: Fills an empty environment from userAgentData, or userAgent. A Detect control fills it again.

api.name: resetAfterSuccessMs / disabled / className
api.description: Clear the form after success, lock the fields, and class the form.

api.name: useBugReportForm
api.description: Headless state for the same fields, files, validation, and submit status. Pass its return as the form prop to render BugReportForm.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by a Design & Code With AV reel. No premium code, class names, colors, or Bootstrap Icons were copied. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, card, input, label, or textarea. The item ships no theme. The live example includes an optional Supabase insert and storage upload for a host that already has a client; this item does not depend on Supabase. With reduced motion the type check does not animate and the spinner does not spin.
